name: read_file
description:
Read an authorized local file by path. Restricted paths stay within current source roots; open mode permits absolute local paths. Returns metadata, text and a citation. Page text with start_line/max_lines. Use edit_file for changes, create_file for new files.

For image inspection, set image_mode="native" without line parameters: approved pixels enter the existing visual route, directly for vision models or through the configured interpreter for text models. PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF are supported; GIF uses its first frame. Omitted image_mode follows privacy settings; "text" forces extraction/OCR.

Without line parameters, PDF/DOCX/PPTX also provide originals to supported native routes when privacy permits. Office input is text-only; PDF can include page images. Explicit line parameters select extraction only. XLSX uses structured extraction.

path.description: Absolute or relative path to the file

start_line.description: 1-based line number to start reading from (default 1)

max_lines.description: Maximum number of lines to return (default 100)

image_mode.description: native: approved image pixels; omit line parameters. text: extraction only. Omitted: follow privacy settings.
